changelog.title: EduScan LearningPaths Validator
changelog.description: New LP-001 validator catches broken module hrefs in LearningPaths.js before deployment. Would have prevented the comptia-linux 404.

changelog.title: Assignment Link Fix
changelog.description: Fixed 404 errors for CompTIA Linux+, Linux Mastery, WSA, and DevOps paths. All certification path hrefs now use absolute paths.

changelog.title: Sorting Quiz V2 + Matrix House
changelog.description: 20 personality-based questions, 11 houses including new Matrix path. No technical knowledge required.

changelog.title: Achievement System Expanded
changelog.description: 146 achievements across 20 categories including Factionless, Operator, Career Paths, Seasonal, Prestige, and Easter Eggs. 64,535 total XP possible.

changelog.title: XP System Unified
changelog.description: Fixed achievement XP to award actual points. Aligned Firestore and localStorage XP values.

changelog.title: Dark Arts CTF Hardened
changelog.description: Removed handholding hints from Gates 1-3. Real CTF now requires real thinking.

changelog.title: Quiz Progress Sync Fix
changelog.description: Fixed 12 quizzes with duplicate house prefix that prevented Handler Dashboard sync.

changelog.title: README & Onboarding
changelog.description: Added Start Here section, architecture diagram, and product framing for new visitors.

changelog.title: Instructor Quickstart
changelog.description: 3-step onboarding guide in Instructor Dashboard empty state.

changelog.title: L-1 Linux Labs Refactored
changelog.description: All 4 Linux labs now use LinuxTerminal.js with 40+ commands, pipes, tab completion, and real permission tracking.
